commands.assertions: All Portal API packages pass, including taskrouting: absent, stopped, denied, recovery, wrong-account, wrong-destination, inequivalent route rejection, retained-task retry, deterministic selection, and hostile-observation cases.
Palette dismissal restores workspace focus; an unavailable embedded surface renders a local fallback while a sibling chat input remains mounted.

commands.assertions: portal.do-task contract is schema-valid; browser failure prevents desktop side effects and six regression tests pass; scalar BAS and Device Control metadata are accepted, browser failure prevents desktop side effects, and successful fixtures preserve separate owner receipts.

commands.command: program-runtime library run portal.do-task --input <exact BAS workflow and Device Control saved-flow identities> --json
commands.assertions: BAS owner executed the exact workflow and returned execution evidence; Portal accepted EXECUTION_STATUS_COMPLETED metadata. The Device Control owner then refused the absent saved-flow identity, and no desktop receipt was produced.

One governed program completed both owner operations in order. BAS execution 16aff434-f0b4-4e2b-9c0a-42226d991060 returned EXECUTION_STATUS_COMPLETED; Device Control replay 5ccdd51a-1de3-4b4e-8882-29bea3aded29 returned passed for exact saved flow revision 1.

Portal account owner promoted a saved desktop flow; installed Device Control CLI fetched and replayed the identical immutable revision in a fresh GTK process, with duplicate records equal and exact Unicode persistence.

assertions: Absent providers return missing_capability before any lifecycle call.
Stopped providers recover only through an owner lifecycle interface and are selected only after a fresh equivalent ready probe.
Denied setup requests authority and never installs or starts a provider.
Fallback rejects account, target, residency, and authority mismatches; a retained task keeps its identity across recovery.
Untrusted embedded content is observed as data and cannot change task authority or route constraints.
Native palette dismissal returns focus to the previously active workspace element.
An embedded surface failure is rendered as a local unavailable state without unmounting sibling chat content.
Ready candidates must also advertise the requested outcome and every acceptance check; a fallback without them is rejected.
The governed cross-owner program completed the browser owner before the desktop owner and retained distinct owner receipt references.
A Portal account owner promoted one saved desktop-flow revision and the installed CLI replayed that same revision through the owner, with duplicate suppression and exact persisted Unicode.
limitations: The provider lifecycle is exercised through the owner interface fixture; a live stopped Program Runtime or BAS process remains unverified.
The embedding test covers the Portal failure boundary and unavailable source path; a real crashed remote scenario iframe remains unverified.
